description.value:
A Cabin Cruiser, Yacht or AeroZep with housing upgrades, at sea or in the air. The first upgrade fits a kitchen, bathroom and bedroom for one; each further upgrade adds a room. Every two rooms (a bedroom and a bathroom) sleep one more, and every other room adds a housing-upgrade slot. You furnish it yourself (ConApt & Apartment sets).

At seven rooms it counts as a Headquarters, but its fuel doubles, with another Ship Fuel every three rooms. Overnight guests need Excellent furnishings in their room or a DV15 Endurance check against a Rough Night.

Counts as Upscale for the monthly check (2d6 Humanity Gain) and as time spent outside the city (1d6). Set sleeps and slots to match your rooms.
